newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberia close to finalising international alliance.
newsitem.headline: Iberia close to finalising international alliance.

text.p: Spanish state-owned airlines Iberia is in the final stages of taks on forming a strategic alliance with an international company, Chairman Xabier de Irala said on Thursday.
"All the options are open, but I won't be able to say anything on this point for a few days," Irala told a news conference.
The talks were down to details, he said.
This spring, an Iberia source mentioned that Iberia was in talks with British Airways on a possible alliance.
Netherlands airline KLM has also been mentioned as another potential candidate.
And State-holding company SEPI has said Iberia would secure an international alliance before the summer with two partners, one American and one European.
